// MODEL //: 2-camera multi-view (bottom camera + one side camera) with dilation 3. Every sample holds the bottom camera in slot 0 plus one of the three side cameras, one sample per side camera (3 per wing per frame); the bottom camera is found from the dataset's camera positions. For rigs with a bottom camera and one side camera; on a 4-camera movie it runs once per (bottom, side) pair. 53 epochs because each epoch holds 3x the samples: 3 x 53 matches the 3-camera models' 4 x 40 frame-passes.
// ORIGIN //: Recipe of config_all_cams_3cam_dil3.json with 2 cameras, the bottom one required, and the epochs rescaled.
